format_date.description: strftime format string for the date shown in the panel (e.g., '%A, %B %d' for 'Monday, January 01').

format_time.description: strftime format string for the time shown in the panel (e.g., '%I:%M %p' for '02:30 PM').

show_seconds.description: Display seconds in the time field.

show_24h.description: Use 24-hour time format instead of 12-hour AM/PM.

auto_locale.description: Automatically set date/time formats based on the system locale.

formats.description: Additional custom date/time formats for secondary clocks or special contexts.

pattern.description: strftime pattern to use for this context.

calendar_file.description: Optional path to a custom ICS or vCard calendar file for holidays/events.

event_notifications.description: Show notifications for upcoming calendar events (requires calendar_file).

font_path.description: Optional path to a TrueType font file for rendering locale-specific glyphs (e.g., CJK characters).

holidays.description: List of holidays to highlight (as ISO dates 'YYYY-MM-DD' or recognized names like 'Easter', 'Christmas').

items.description: Holiday identifier (ISO date or name like 'NewYear', 'Easter').
